item.title: 基于光热烧蚀耦合和BP神经网络代理模型的多层异质薄膜激光烧蚀抗性优化
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Yuyang Shen, Shu Zheng, Duanpeng He, Yang Cui, Yan Li, Yuxiong Xue
多层异质薄膜在连续波激光加热下的热物理响应涉及由干涉引起的驻波吸收调制的不均匀体积发热，它控制着逐层相变序列和最终的热失效阈值——传统比尔-朗伯近似无法捕获的耦合。这项研究开发了一种光热烧蚀耦合模型，该模型可以解析驻波吸收曲线，并将其与具有潜热效应的温度相关瞬态热传导耦合，并在七个功率级别的激光损伤实验中进行了验证。构建了一个基于两阶段替代的框架来探索热物理设计空间，其中离散材料选择和连续层厚度共同控制吸收分布和熔化顺序。

item.title: Toward chemically accurate quantum simulations on quantum hardware: A quantum-HPC hybrid approach
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
We report one of the most comprehensive experimental demonstrations to date of quantum-computing-based molecular simulation on IQM’s Sirius 24-qubit superconducting quantum processor, using up to 16 operational qubits. We employ Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) with the Local Unitary Cluster Jastrow (LUCJ) Ansatz to compute ground-state energies of benchmark molecular systems, including H 2 , LiH, BeH 2 , H 2 O, and NH 3 . We further introduce the linear-CNOT unitary coupled-cluster singles and doubles Ansatz within the SQD framework, reducing the classical pre-computation overhead at the cost of increased quantum circuit depth and demonstrate its effectiveness by accurately recovering the ground-state energies of H 2 , LiH, and BeH 2 . A comparative analysis of the two Ansätze…

item.title: QEpy: Quantum ESPRESSO in python
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
QEpy is a Python electronic-structure software package based on Quantum ESPRESSO (QE). QEpy accomplishes two goals. First, it simplifies running and prototyping calculations with QE. Second, it targets nonstandard workflows where the electronic-structure engine is used in ways for which it was not originally designed. For example, QEpy can instruct QE to run with custom potentials in the Hamiltonian, including external, exchange-correlation, and local pseudopotentials. QEpy also exposes, at any point during an electronic-structure calculation, including between self-consistent-field cycles, quantities that would normally be accessible only through post-processing, such as the electron density and wavefunctions. QEpy’s API to the Atomic Simulation Environment gives direct access to ASE-bas…

item.title: Substantial Reduction of Hole Injection Barrier at the Au/Rubrene Organic Semiconductor Interface Using PFBT Self-Assembled Monolayers
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Woojin Shin, Hyunbok Lee
Surface functionalization using self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) is an effective and widely adopted strategy for optimizing the charge injection and interfacial energetics in organic electronic devices. In particular, 2,3,4,5,6-pentafluorothiophenol (PFBT) SAMs are widely employed to augment the work function of noble metal electrodes, such as Au, and favorably template organic semiconductor molecular packing. However, comprehensive in situ spectroscopic investigations detailing the thickness-dependent energy-level alignment across the PFBT-modified Au/organic semiconductor interface remain scarce.
